honest.coded: Maps of coded actions: every point is an action someone coded, not GPS tracking.
honest.tracking: Distance, speed and sprints need a tracking camera: that is on the roadmap.

maps.title: Match maps
maps.subtitle: Where the actions happened, with us attacking left to right. Tap a point to watch that moment on the video.
maps.partial: {{placed}} of our {{total}} coded actions have a position on the pitch: the maps show those.
maps.noPositions: None of the actions you chose has a position on the pitch.
maps.noPositionsMatch: The actions of this match have no position yet. Open the video and code with “Place on the pitch”: every placed action shows up here.
maps.noVideo: This match has no linked video: the points do not open a moment.

shots.aria: Shot map: {{us}} shots for us, {{them}} for the opponent

network.empty: Not enough passes placed with their passer to draw the network.
network.node: {{name}}, {{passes}} passes. Tap to see his links.
network.hint: Tap a player to isolate his links.
network.legendNode: Average position of the passes played (size: number of passes)
network.legendLink: Completed passes between two players (thickness: number)
network.how: {{n}} completed passes with their receiver coded. A player's point is the average of where he played his passes, not a tracked position.

heat.empty: No placed action for this choice.
heat.how: Density of the coded and placed on-ball actions. The percentages at the top give the share of each third.

sp.empty: No set piece coded in this match. Code corners, free kicks, penalties and throw-ins on the video to see them here.

territory.aria: Territory: {{def}} of our actions in our third, {{mid}} in the middle, {{att}} in their third
territory.tiltPos: Our share of the actions played in the attacking thirds (ours in their third, theirs in ours).
territory.tiltCodes: Our final third entries against those of both teams.
territory.tiltMissing: Needs coding: field tilt compares our actions in their third with theirs in ours. Code their passes and final third entries too (keys Q, W and E).
territory.possTime: Estimated from the duration of our coded sequences: the opponent's passes are not coded.
territory.possMissing: Not enough coded actions to estimate it.
territory.how: Share of our placed on-ball actions in each third, from our goal to theirs.

shot.unplaced_one: {{count}} action without a position is not on the map.
shot.unplaced_other: {{count}} actions without a position are not on the map.

def.hint: A loss in our third costs the most; a regain in their third pays the most.

players.title: Players
players.subtitle: What each player did, according to the coded actions. The play button runs his moments one after another on the video.
players.empty: No action of this match is credited to a player. On the video, pick the player after each action to fill this tab.
players.potmPick: Choose the player of the match
players.scoreHow: Contribution: a reading of the codes, not a rating. Progressive 1, line broken 1.5, final third entry 1, box entry 1.5, shot 1, on target 1, goal 4, won back in 5 s 1.5, regain 1, pin 1, completed pass 0.1; pass lost minus 0.6, loss minus 1.

chrono.title: Timeline
chrono.subtitle: How the match went: who pushed, when, and every coded action to watch again.
chrono.momentumHow: Danger over a rolling 5 minutes: final third entry {{fin}}, box entry {{box}}, shot {{shot}}, on target plus 1, goal plus 2. Us above, the opponent below.
chrono.momentumAria: Match momentum minute by minute, our danger above the line, the opponent's below
chrono.blocks: Njangi Index by quarter of an hour
chrono.blocksHow: Computed from the codes of each 15-minute block. In a short block a few actions move the number a lot: read the trend.

assist.title: Ask Mola
assist.name: Mola
assist.how: Mola reads the {{n}} coded actions of this match and answers with fixed sentences, worked out on your device. No connection, no online AI: the same codes always give the same answer.
assist.hello: The match against {{opp}} is coded. Pick a question or write your own: I answer from the codes.
assist.helpHint: Try one of the questions below.
assist.footer: A reading of the match codes, not an opinion: check it on the video.

q.losses: Where do we lose the ball?

mola.thirds: {{def}} in our third, {{mid}} in the middle, {{att}} in their third

sum.indice: Njangi Index: {{v}} out of 100, {{label}}. Strongest: {{best}} ({{bv}} out of 20). To work on: {{worst}} ({{wv}} out of 20).
sum.blocks: Our best quarter of an hour: minutes {{a}} to {{b}} (Index {{v}}). The hardest: minutes {{c}} to {{d}} ({{w}}).
sum.top: Most present in the codes: {{name}}, {{n}} actions, contribution {{score}}.
sum.potm: Player of the match chosen by the staff: {{name}}.
sum.prevUp: That is {{d}} Index points more than against {{opp}}.
sum.prevDown: That is {{d}} Index points fewer than against {{opp}}.

trends.where: Our on-ball actions: {{def}} in our third, {{mid}} in the middle, {{att}} in their third.
trends.lane: We enter the final third mostly through {{lane}}: {{share}} of our {{n}} placed entries.
trends.strings_one: {{count}} sequence of 5 passes or more, the longest {{max}} passes.
trends.strings_other: {{count}} sequences of 5 passes or more, the longest {{max}} passes.
trends.progress: {{rate}} of our passes move the play forward (progressive passes and lines broken), with {{k}} retention.
trends.halvesUp: Index by half: {{h1}} then {{h2}}. We finished stronger.
trends.halvesDown: Index by half: {{h1}} then {{h2}}. We dropped in the second half.
trends.halvesFlat: Index by half: {{h1}} then {{h2}}. A steady level from one half to the other.

opp.where: From inside our box: {{inBox}}; from further out: {{out}}. Average distance: {{m}} metres.
opp.when: Their shots by half: {{h1}} in the first, {{h2}} in the second.
opp.origin_one: Of their {{total}} shots, {{count}} came within a minute of a ball we lost. Where we had lost it: {{where}}.
opp.origin_other: Of their {{total}} shots, {{count}} came within a minute of a ball we lost. Where we had lost it: {{where}}.
opp.possPasses: Their possession: {{v}}, from both teams' passes.
opp.possTime: Their estimated possession: {{v}}, from the duration of our coded sequences.
opp.coded: Their coded passes: {{n}}, {{acc}} completed. Entries into our final third: {{f3}}.
opp.limit: Only their shots and goals are coded in this match. To read their passing and their final third entries, code their actions too (keys Q, W and E).

eff.main: Shots: {{shots}}; on target: {{on}} ({{onPct}}); goals: {{goals}}, a conversion of {{conv}}.
eff.box: Shots inside the box: {{inBox}}, goals: {{gIn}}. Shots from further out: {{out}}, goals: {{gOut}}.
eff.dist: Average distance of our shots: {{m}} metres from goal.
eff.chain: Final third entries: {{f3}}; box entries: {{box}}; shots: {{shots}}. One shot every {{per}} final third entries.

loss.main: Balls lost: {{n}} (passes lost: {{passes}}, lost on the ball: {{balls}}).
loss.lane: By lane: {{l}} on our left, {{c}} in the centre, {{r}} on our right.
loss.danger: Losses in our third cost the most: {{count}} in this match. Opponent shots within a minute of one of them: {{shots}}.
loss.dangerNone: No loss in our third: the build-up held.
loss.who: Most exposed: {{list}}. They are often the players who touch the ball the most.
loss.react: After a loss we win the ball back within 5 seconds in {{rate}} of cases ({{r5}} out of {{n}}).

str.lead: Strengths and weaknesses read from the five sub-indices, out of 20:
str.worst: First thing to fix: {{name}}. Suggested drills: {{drills}}.

pl.lead: Most influential according to the codes (progressions, entries, shots and regains count, losses take away):
pl.passer: Best passer: {{name}}, {{ok}} passes completed out of {{n}} ({{acc}}).
pl.regainer: Best ball winner: {{name}}, balls won back: {{n}}, {{r5}} of them within 5 seconds.
pl.potm: Player of the match chosen by the staff: {{name}}.
pl.noPotm: No player of the match chosen yet: the Players tab lets you pick one.

press.main: Won back within 5 seconds: {{r5}}; slower regains: {{r}}. Win-back rate: {{rate}} of our losses.
press.where: Where we win it back: {{where}}. High regains, in their third: {{high}}.
press.good: The reaction to losing the ball is good: the benchmark of 40 regains within 5 seconds per 100 losses is reached.
press.work: The reaction to losing the ball needs work: the benchmark is 40 regains within 5 seconds per 100 losses.

poss.time: Estimated possession: {{v}}, from the duration of our coded sequences (the opponent's passes are not coded).
poss.none: Not enough coded actions to estimate possession.
poss.keep: Retention: {{k}} of our on-ball actions keep the ball, {{ok}} passes completed out of {{n}}.
poss.tilt: Field tilt: {{v}} of the actions played in the attacking thirds are ours.
poss.noTilt: Field tilt needs their final third actions coded too.

mola.help: I read the {{n}} coded actions of this match. I can answer about the match summary, our trends, how they played, our finishing, where we lose the ball, our strengths and weaknesses, the most influential players, our pressing and possession. Ask in your own words.

season.notCoded: Match not coded: only the score is known.

tile.possPasses_other: share of passes, over {{count}} coded matches

season.progressionHint: The last ten matches played, oldest to newest. Tap a bar for the detail.
season.positionsFor_one: Positions available for {{count}} match out of {{total}} played.
season.positionsFor_other: Positions available for {{count}} matches out of {{total}} played.
season.mapsEmpty: No match in the period has placed actions. Code a match on its video with “Place on the pitch” to fill these maps.
season.compareOpp_one: Our team and the opponent, over {{count}} match played against them.
season.compareOpp_other: Our team and the opponent, over {{count}} matches played against them.
season.compareTeam_one: The averages of the two club teams ({{count}} match played by the other team).
season.compareTeam_other: The averages of the two club teams ({{count}} matches played by the other team).
season.radarHow: Each axis runs from zero to a reference value (3 goals, 8 shots on target, 100% possession, 450 completed passes, 40% conversion, 100% wins), or higher when one of the two teams goes beyond it.
season.radarMissing: A dotted axis is not coded for the opponent: in a match coded live, we code their shots and goals, not their passes.
season.radarClub: When the club has several teams, they appear in the list too.
season.counted_one: {{played}} matches played in the period, {{count}} of them coded.
season.counted_other: {{played}} matches played in the period, {{count}} of them coded.
